_note: Site traits (#430): a hole founded after the first takes the trait of its place on the map, fixed by place, not rolled. Each eases one system and stresses another. Traits are tried in order and the first whose `where` matches wins; a site matching none has no trait. where: absLatMin / absLatMax (degrees from the equator), near (a feature kind in mars-features.json) within nearDeg degrees. effects: output multiplies what a kind of room makes (and uses) per tick; digYields adds goods per slot dug (as a deposit does); restC shifts floor 1's resting temperature (°C) and restCapC raises its cap (temperature.restCapC otherwise); stormChance and stormLength multiply the dust storms' chance per day and how long they blow.

traits.name: Geothermal
traits.blurb: Warm rock under an old volcano: the floors rest warm, but the water comes up hard with minerals.
traits.eases: Heat: floors rest near 65 °F, so heaters are rarely needed
traits.stresses: Water: recyclers work a fifth slower on the hard water

traits.name: Ice
traits.blurb: Ground ice under the high latitudes: digging brings up water, but the sun sits low.
traits.eases: Water: every slot dug brings up water
traits.stresses: Power: solar arrays make 15% less under the low sun

traits.name: Equatorial
traits.blurb: High sun on the equator: easy power, and the dust storms that come with it.
traits.eases: Power: solar arrays make a third more
traits.stresses: Dust: storms come twice as often and blow half again as long
